title: アルダンの寄り道講座・変則編

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan and I have just finished our errands when I happen to glance at my watch. It's still a little soon to be heading back…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Might I interest you in another small detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Great. Now, where shall we go today…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Oh! Hello, Ardan! And her trainer, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Greetings, Spe, Oguri. Are you on an excursion?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Spe and I are heading to this ramen place called Hefty Noodle Hammerbolt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hammerbolt… That's a unique name, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Do you want to check it out?
Do you want to check it out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, venturing into the unknown is the true charm of the detour. As a connoisseur, I cannot pass up this opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So… shall we join them on this venture? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we head to the Hefty Noodle Hammerbolt.. Upon arriving, however…

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: Heavy on the veg, ultra heavy oil, and gigante garly!

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text: Pork triad, heavy oil, light garly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Veg? Garly? Wh-what could they be talking about? …Are all the customers here speaking in code?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll have a pork triad, extra heavy on veg and oil, with a garly giant!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: One Mariana Trench Olympus Eruption, quinty pork, and go ultra heavy on everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …?! You two as well?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yep… Ardan, don't tell me… this is your first time?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'd be happy to teach you the lingo! Pork is the main attraction here, and you have to call out what you want instead of—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I appreciate the offer, but this is all part of the detour experience… And, as a connoisseur, the least I can do is place an order unassisted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Don't fret… If I listen closely, I should be able to decipher the keywords.

text_block_list.name: Customer C
text_block_list.text: Quarty pork, heavy on the veg!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Customer
text_block_list.text: Quinty thick pork with a veg Everest! And go ultra super heavy on the oil!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I think I understand. "Veg" and "garly" are vegetables and garlic, while the heaviness indicates the portion size.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Then "quarty" and "quinty" refer to the complexity and thickness of the broth. Like quartets and quintets performing for the taste buds!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Additionally, those mountain names they're calling out must serve… to invoke grand visions of flavor!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes… I understand what everybody's saying! I… I can place an order! The time has come!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Comin' up! Veg Hua, light garly, hexa pork.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are you… sure about this, Ardan?! That bowl looks like the ruins of an ancient veggie and pork kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Don't strain yourself. We'll help you finish. Besides, that combo intrigues me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am the one who summoned forth this monstrosity. What am I to do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am the one who summoned forth this monstrosity. What am I to do?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Exactly! The important thing is to enjoy the food, without having to force it down!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I was just thinking that mine wasn't really heavy enough on its own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But… you two shouldn't have to suffer for my ineptitude…
choice_data_list: The point of detours is to have fun, right?
The point of detours is to have fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes, you're right. Well said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Right then… I shall humbly accept your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Whew… Due in no small part to your help, that dish was quite enjoyable. Thank you very much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you for sharing! Going for a six on the pork broth was intense!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I've never felt this full before. I'm going to follow your example next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I was worried for a moment there, it looks like this detour has ended up as a pleasant memory for everyone involved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes. As the one who placed the order, it falls to me to slay this beast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm unsure as to how long my stomach will hold out…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But that's precisely why I'm going to focus exclusively on the task before me. I shall unleash my full power… here and now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The time has come… Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Ardan gallantly gets to work. Soon, however…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …It's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her attempt to best the beast she called forth ends in a disheartened defeat…
